Āucā
or ADavA zukladIkSita preceptor of Tryambakabhaṭṭa (son of Kṛṣṇabhaṭṭa), a. of Ādhānaprayoga (C.. I. 411).
--Āpastambāgnihotrahoma. Mentions Bhaṭṭoji's work on the subject. C.. I. 619. II. 237.
--Aikāhikacāturmāsyaprayoga. RASB. 762. C.. next.
--Aikāhikapaśucāturmāsyaprayoga. (Śāṅkh.) Baroda 7760.
--Prāyaścittasāra. Q. in Pratāpanārasiṁha of Rudradeva (BBRAS. 703).
